sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Specialized Air/Sea Transport of Regulated Hazardous Chemicals

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary 'kastom' law; unitary national legal system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus; in force for Vanuatu since 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group Framework Trade Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 17 of 2014 as amended; Companies (Amendment) Act No. 21 of 2017 and International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 22 of 2017 (beneficial ownership register obligations); Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act No. 26 of 2005; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of origin, with certification by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a Contracting State to the Hague Apostille Convention) or, for non-Apostille states, full consular legalization through notary, foreign affairs ministry, and Vanuatu consulate/embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or current commercial registry extract of any ultimate corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or registered agent of the parent entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in the jurisdiction of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any ultimate corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the parent entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in the jurisdiction of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address for each director and beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or banking institution, with notary public attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization where the issuing jurisdiction requires external authentication

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing SWIFT wire and documentary Letter of Credit transactional capacity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Banker's affidavit sworn before a notary public, followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of Wealth and Source of Funds attestation executed on the VFSC-licensed agent's AML/CFT enhanced due diligence questionnaire
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC-licensed registered agent, signed by each beneficial owner before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of signature pages and, where executed outside Vanuatu, Hague Apostille or consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, their immediate family members, and dangerous goods counterparties against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List (resolutions 1267/1988/1373 regimes), domestic designations under the Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act No. 26 of 2005, the OFAC SDN and 50% ownership lists, and the European Union consolidated financial sanctions list. Because the target payment rails are SWIFT wire and USD-denominated documentary letters of credit, OFAC compliance is contractually imposed by the correspondent banking chain. PEPs are classified as mandatory high-risk; enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring are required under the AML/CFT Act No. 17 of 2014 and the VFSC AML/CFT Rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry Online Services (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script; English and French names are accepted, with Bislama tolerated in practice. Non-Latin characters (e.g., Cyrillic, Chinese, Arabic script) are not permitted in the registered name; any foreign-language brand name must be transliterated into Latin characters. An International Company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd', and the Registrar applies a phonetic and visual 'confusingly similar' comparison test against the existing register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Royal, Imperial, Government, Municipal (prohibited entirely as implying state patronage)
Vanuatu or any name suggesting connection with the Government of Vanuatu (requires prior ministerial consent)
Bank, Trust, Insurance, Assurance, Chartered, Cooperative, Building Society, Chamber of Commerce (prohibited without a relevant VFSC or ministerial license)
Limited and Ltd (restricted to companies validly constituted under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222])
Tokens connoting hazardous, dangerous, or military activity are not statutorily prohibited but trigger enhanced VFSC AML/CFT risk review for this industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC Registrar issues a written statement of grounds. The applicant may, within 14 calendar days of rejection, file a written appeal with the Registrar of Companies, attaching the original reservation receipt, the rejection notice, and any ministerial consent letters. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 10 working days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may submit a fresh name reservation or pursue judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Civil Procedure Rules. An approved reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period by lodging VFSC Form NR-EXT with the applicable extension fee before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted for an International Company. A physical registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent is mandatory; a virtual office cannot satisfy the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] requirement. Board and shareholder meetings may, however, validly be held outside Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate. Unannounced on-site inspections of registered agent portfolios by the VFSC supervision team occur in approximately 15-20% of licensed agents annually; the likelihood rises above 70% where adverse AML/CFT reports, sanctions hits, or dangerous-goods-related suspicious transaction reports are identified.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation fee for an International Company (one 30-day reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation and registration of memorandum and articles of association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation fee scaled by authorized capital class

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register preparation and initial filing with the VFSC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC administrative filing tariff for beneficial ownership returns

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service (year one)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed agent services in Vanuatu

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client on-boarding, PEP and sanctions screening, and enhanced due diligence file for a high-risk DG forwarding entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / compliance service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for CDD/EDD obligations under the AML/CFT Act No. 17 of 2014

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille, and consular legalization of KYC and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, competent apostille authority, and Vanuatu consulate/embassy as applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official authority tariffs plus prevailing notarial market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter and SWIFT / Letter of Credit eligibility verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff for corporate reference letter and SWIFT network due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal opinion on International Company tax-exempt status and DG forwarding license scope
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional fee quote, invoice-based, under customary Vanuatu Bar Association billing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC annual supervision levy for high-risk licensed file (prorated for the first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC annual fees regulation applied to high-risk supervised entities

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 191), ss 10 (incorporation), 12 (registered office), 23 (shares), 44 (directors), 89 (exemptions); Companies (Amendment) Act 2014; AML/CFT Act No. 60 of 2019
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry Section, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (VFSC Incorporation Application Form IC-001)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued share capital and no mandatory paid-up capital or escrow account under the International Companies Act. If any share capital is adopted, at least one share must be issued upon incorporation; no government escrow is required, although the VFSC-registered agent may hold client funds in a segregated trust account under AML/CFT rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BY WRITTEN RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [Company Name] (the "Company"), adopted as of [Date], pursuant to the International Companies Act, Cap. 191 and the Company's Articles, it is RESOLVED as follows: 1. The allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares with no par value to the subscribers named in the subscription lists is hereby ratified and confirmed. 2. The registered office located at [Street Address], Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the appointment of [Agent Name] as registered agent are hereby approved. 3. [Director Name] is appointed as director; [Officer Name] is appointed as secretary; each is authorized to act singly. 4. The officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute filings, and pay all statutory fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Approval of Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agents; International Companies Act 1992, s. 12(2)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a VFSC-licensed registered agent to act as the company's agent and to supply a registered office address in Vanuatu. Execute the agent engagement letter, provide KYC documentation, and obtain the agent's signed consent together with the registered-office address consent. The address must be a physical street address, not a post office box.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner and directors
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
Bank and business reference letter or KYC questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent declines appointment or VFSC rejects the registered office address, select another VFSC-licensed agent and re-file the consent forms; the constitutional documents are unaffected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Affairs Unit - online name reservation module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three ranked proposed company names in the prescribed order without undertaking any licensed banking, insurance, or trust business. Pay the name-reservation fee and identify the intended scope as specialized air/sea transport and freight forwarding of regulated dangerous goods. Upon clearance, VFSC issues a name-reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (optional at this stage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is refused for identity or confusion with an existing company, the applicant may rely on the second or third name from the same tripartite submission without paying a further reservation fee, provided the alternative was originally filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarisation of Corporate Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu notary public or licensed international company service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including a broad objects clause authorizing the specialized transport, transhipment, and freight forwarding of dangerous goods by air and sea, while prohibiting any domestic business in Vanuatu without a further licence. Execute the document by subscriber signatures, call a board resolution subscribing to shares, and notarize the execution pages.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in final notarized form
Consent of each director and secretary to act
Written resolution subscribing to the initial share issue
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises capacity or authority questions for a corporate shareholder, cure by providing a certified registry extract of the corporate shareholder and a duly executed power of attorney or board authorization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - e-registration portal or physical counter, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed incorporation application, including Form IC-001, notarized Memorandum and Articles, name-reservation certificate, registered agent consent, registered office consent, and director/secretary consents. Pay the USD 250 official state filing fee by bank transfer or card. Retain the VFSC payment receipt and acknowledgement reference.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent consent and registered office consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query notice, the applicant has 14 days to submit a written explanation, corrected forms, or additional notarized evidence. If the query relates to documents only and the name is unaffected, no new name-reservation is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Exempt Company Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all statutory requirements, VFSC registers the International Company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the company number. Verify that the certificate shows the correct company name, date of incorporation, registered office, and registered agent. Obtain certified copies of the Certificate and of the Memorandum and Articles from VFSC.
required_dossiers: VFSC acknowledgement and incorporation application file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If there is a typographical or clerical variance in the Certificate of Incorporation, file a written rectification request with the VFSC Registry under the administrative correction procedure; no full incorporation re-run is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolutions and Establishment of Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent's corporate registry and company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, convene the first board of directors to adopt the formal written board resolutions regarding share subscription, registered office adoption, officer appointments, share certificate issuance, and banking mandates. Establish the register of directors, register of shareholders, register of charges, and beneficial ownership register, each maintained by the registered agent in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Register of directors, shareholders, and charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial ownership or annual return filing is deficient, file a corrective declaration with the registered agent and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit within 30 days; no court procedure is required for voluntary correction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism and Foreign Direct Investment, in coordination with the Vanuatu Maritime Authority, Civil Aviation Authority of Vanuatu, and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Dangerous Goods Handling, Storage and Forwarding Operator Licence under the Vanuatu Maritime Act [Cap. 131], the Civil Aviation (Dangerous Goods) Regulations, and the VFSC External Carrier Licence (where applicable)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Registration (Category B) for a DG freight-forwarding operation without major physical installations or thermal/chemical treatment; a Full EIA Report (Category A) is required if the project includes hazardous-waste handling, fuel storage above 20,000 litres, or permanent storage of more than 50 IMCO-classed containers.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: All effluent from spill-containment systems must meet Vanuatu National Water Quality Standards (no visible oil sheen, pH 6-9, COD/BOD within prescribed discharge limits); vapour recovery or VOC containment is required at loading/unloading racks; dangerous goods packaging and labelling must comply with the IMDG Code and IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; transboundary waste consignments must be manifested in accordance with the Basel Convention.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for any DG storage or handling area; structural load inspection and clearance from the Department of Public Works for warehouses and container yards; workplace health and safety clearance under the Occupational Health and Safety legislation; and a dangerous-goods storage classification approval from the Vanuatu Maritime Authority or Civil Aviation Authority, as applicable to the mode of transport.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; corporate registry and licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Primary portals: dcir.gov.vu for customs/import-export codes and vfsc.vu for International Company registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No national TIN exists because Vanuatu imposes no income tax. A foreign-owned International Company (IC) obtains its unique legal identity via the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act Cap 222. For physical movement of dangerous goods cargo, the IC must additionally obtain a Customs Importer/Exporter Client Code from DCIR (lodged through ASYCUDA World) and hold the HF/VFSC-licensed dangerous goods forwarding authorization before filing the first export declaration. Municipal Service Tax registration is triggered only if the IC later supplies prescribed onshore services (accommodation, food and beverage, vehicle hire) inside Port Vila or Luganville, which is outside the offshore DG freight model.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (International Company under Cap 222, carrying on business wholly outside Vanuatu; statutory 20-year income tax exemption guarantee; non-resident owned; zero minimum capital).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available because no direct tax is enacted. The sole classification mechanism is the IC status election under the International Companies Act, including voluntary conversion to/from domestic company form via VFSC filing and payment of fixed registration/stamp fees; no tax rulings or advance pricing agreements are issued by DCIR.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no national VAT/GST or sales and use tax enacted); indirect levies are limited to customs import/export duties, excise on alcohol/tobacco, and municipal Service Tax on prescribed onshore hospitality services. Nationwide VAT reform has been repeatedly deferred.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no national VAT/GST threshold exists. Municipal Service Tax registration attaches to prescribed onshore services (accommodation, food and beverage, vehicle hire) rather than to turnover; the offshore IC's forwarding services fall outside this nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None – no real-time fiscal clearance, mandatory e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime. DCIR operates the ASYCUDA World electronic customs single-window for declarant filing, but clearance is not real-time and no API-based fiscal data feed is required for exporters.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – with no VAT in force, there is no 0% export VAT claim or VAT refund mechanism. The IC's freight services are offshore-source and wholly outside the Vanuatu tax net. Tangible exports are exempt from customs duties, except a narrow list of primary products (copra, kava and similar) subject to export duty; dangerous goods forwarding services are not dutiable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: VU Customs Export Declaration (lodged electronically in ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading (sea) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing the DG consignment
Dangerous Goods Shippers' Declaration (IMDG certificate for sea; IATA DGR Declaration for air)
Valid VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing Certificate of the International Company
Commercial invoice, packing list, and underlying Letter of Credit or SWIFT MT103 remittance where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export VAT clawback exists absent VAT. DCIR and VFSC scrutiny focuses on substance and source: if the IC carries on business with Vanuatu residents or earns Vanuatu-source income, the Cap 222 exemption is void ab initio, exposing the IC to civil fines, deregistration, and recovery of all taxes that would have applied. Customs false-export declarations attract seizure of goods, monetary penalties up to three times the duty evaded, and criminal prosecution for smuggling. Failure to maintain offshore-source books and records triggers VFSC license suspension and director-level liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV); exchange control administration is additionally vested in the Ministry of Finance of Vanuatu under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 46), with supervisory authority over authorized dealer banks exercised solely by the RBV pursuant to the Financial Institutions Act (Cap. 58).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on the current account consistent with Vanuatu's IMF Article VIII obligations; the capital account is highly liberalized and non-resident investment into an International Company (IC) does not require prior RBV exchange-control approval. The International Companies Act (Cap. 222) expressly confers banking and exchange-control privileges on a compliant IC, permitting unrestricted foreign-currency deposits and remittance of profits, dividends, and liquidation proceeds to non-resident shareholders. Vanuatu imposes no income tax, no withholding tax, and no capital gains tax on the IC or its shareholders, so no tax-clearance certificate is required as a precondition to repatriation; the only practical frictions are correspondent-bank fees, domestic liquidity depth for VUV, and the bank's own AML/KYC documentary gates for high-risk dangerous-goods forwarding.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 46), export receipts earned by a Vanuatu-domiciled exporter of record are required to be repatriated through an authorized dealer bank within three (3) months of shipment and are subject to a mandatory conversion ratio to VUV of up to 100%, unless a Foreign Currency Retention Account has been pre-approved by the RBV-authorized dealer. A Vanuatu International Company engaged purely as a specialized DG forwarding agent is not the exporter of record; therefore, statutory surrender attaches only to domestically earned VUV-denominated commission and agency fees, while USD/AUD charter, freight, and dangerous-goods handling disbursements received under principal-to-principal offshore contracts may be retained in foreign currency without conversion. Where the IC nevertheless books trade receivables in VUV, the full 100% surrender and three-month repatriation timeline applies, and a written retention facility should be obtained from the authorized dealer in advance to avoid breach.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VUV Current Account with Foreign Currency (USD/AUD) Retention Facility
Operational Current Account with SWIFT/Correspondent Clearing and Separate Capital Escrow Account
Operational Current Account and Trade Finance Account for Documentary Credit Support
Operational Disbursement Account with European Union Correspondent Corridor

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low; the Vanuatu Financial Institutions Act (Cap. 58) requires any business carrying on banking or deposit-taking activity in or from Vanuatu to hold an RBV license, and no separately regulated digital Electronic Money Institution (EMI) regime exists locally. Global or offshore digital EMIs cannot clear VUV, cannot access SWIFT settlement in Vanuatu for the IC's purpose, and routinely decline high-risk ISIC 5229 hazardous-chemical forwarding clients. An offshore EMI may be used only as a non-core auxiliary collection wallet and can never satisfy the 'authorized dealer bank account' evidence required by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, insurers, or downstream counterparties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person identification of at least one director, each ultimate beneficial owner, and the authorized signatory is mandatory for first-time onboarding of a Vanuatu International Company carrying the high-risk DG-forwarding classification. No domestic commercial bank permits fully remote account opening for this risk tier; a licensed Vanuatu registered agent must physically introduce the IC at the Port Vila branch, the UBOs must attend either in person or through the bank's recorded video interview facilitated by the introducing agent, and all corporate, identity, and UBO documents must be certified by a Port Vila notary public. Subsequent signatory changes, security-access requests, and high-value wire disbursements also require a local signatory presence or dual-control authorization executed through the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification: ISIC 5229 dangerous-goods forwarding with potential dual-use or sanctions-exposed chemical consignments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC special license for dangerous-goods forwarding, Vanuatu Department of Customs registration certificate, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations and International Maritime Dangerous Goods certificates, Dangerous Goods Declaration for each consignment, documented consignor and consignee screening policy, US/EU/UN consolidated sanctions screening log, and end-user certificates for regulated chemical cargo.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Layered ownership, nominee arrangements, or opaque beneficial ownership of the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certificate of corporate records, updated register of members and beneficial ownership register, any trust deed and deed of indemnity governing nominee shareholdings, UBO identification documents, source-of-wealth report supported by bank records, and an independent legal opinion confirming the economic substance and legitimate ownership of the Vanuatu IC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from non-resident shareholders with insufficiently demonstrated provenance of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder's audited or accountant-certified financial statements, complete remitting-bank statement evidencing the fund trail, resolution approving share allotment, signed board minutes, certificate of incorporation and good-standing certificate from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and a notarized source-of-funds declaration confirming that no proceeds derive from unlawful activity or sanctioned persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical presence, substance, or operational nexus in Vanuatu including lack of local records and agent arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or serviced-office agreement in Port Vila, engagement contracts of the local registered agent and compliance officer, local payroll or service-fee records, Vanuatu telephone and data records, freight-transaction bookkeeping system hosted or administered in Vanuatu, and a substance memorandum mapping ISIC 5229 operations against RBV and VFSC expectations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-flow opacity: high-volume outbound disbursements to carriers, port authorities, customs brokers, and hazmat handlers lacking underlying trade documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Freight-forwarding service agreements, client purchase orders and contract of carriage, pro-forma commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and air waybills, dangerous-goods declarations, Vanuatu customs entry receipts, approved-counterparty list for each disbursement corridor, and periodic reconciliation reports submitted to the bank's relationship manager.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 in USD, AUD, or EUR from the shareholder's remitting bank into the IC's Capital Escrow Account held with the Vanuatu authorized dealer; the remittance instruction must include the purpose descriptor 'direct equity investment for international dangerous-goods freight forwarding working capital', which maps to the Vanuatu balance-of-payments classification for equity shares in an International Company under the financial account direct-investment category. On receipt, the funds are either credited to the IC's foreign-currency account or converted into VUV at the prevailing dealer rate. The IC must deliver within five business days (i) the share-allotment board resolution, (ii) the updated register of members and UBO register, (iii) the registered agent's confirmation of corporate good standing, (iv) the remitting bank's source-of-funds statement, and (v) a notarized UBO declaration; failure to deliver these records will trigger a compliant hold-back and potential account restriction under the bank's AML/CFT policy.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational trade settlements clear through SWIFT MT103 priority wires from the Vanuatu operational account using the purpose description 'freight forwarding and logistics services'; this rail supports payments to ocean and air carriers, port authorities, customs brokers, hazmat-certified warehousing, and contracted DG handling agents. Recurring charter or consolidated-cargo payments above the USD-equivalent of 50,000 are further supported by irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP600) issued or confirmed by the Vanuatu authorized dealer, while standby letters of credit are deployed as customs-bond guarantees to the Vanuatu Department of Customs. The IC exporting via this blueprint must maintain strict principal-versus-agent fund segregation between client-controlled cargo receipts and its own commission income so that clearing flows do not create constructive taxable service revenue inside Vanuatu and do not compromise the IC's tax-exempt status.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward contracts in VUV/USD executed with a Vanuatu authorized dealer bank, tenor up to twelve months, supported by board-approved treasury policy and documented exposure from freight invoices or charter-party payments.

Deliverable VUV/AUD and VUV/EUR forward contracts and cross-currency swaps concluded with the Vanuatu authorized dealer to hedge operating-cost corridors and European or Australian counterparty flows, each supported by a board treasury resolution and a confirmed underlying commercial transaction.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards referencing the VUV/USD exchange rate executed through the shareholder group's treasury or a licensed offshore broker outside Vanuatu, permissible strictly on a hedging-only basis with a dedicated hedge-file evidencing each underlying exposure and retained for review by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission on substance assessments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form IC-AR) for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each incorporation anniversary; no statutory extension available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 25,000 (approx. USD 210) per month or part thereof; default exceeding 3 months after formal notice leads to administrative strike-off and vesting of assets in the Republic of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Prescribed Fee (renewal of company registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Revenue and Corporate Registry Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the incorporation anniversary each year; 30-day grace period only with written extension approved by registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late penalty of 10% on unpaid fee; failure to settle within 3 months triggers gazetted strike-off notice under International Companies Act [Cap 222].

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with the Annual Return within 60 days of incorporation anniversary; additionally due within 14 days of any share transfer or change of significant control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty up to VT 500,000 (approx. USD 4,200) against the company and each defaulting director; registered agent license suspension for repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the end of the company's declared financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty of VT 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,400) plus exchange of information report to the relevant foreign tax authority.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dangerous Goods (DG) Freight Forwarding License Annual Endorsement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Civil Aviation Authority (air cargo) or Vanuatu Maritime and Ports Authority (sea cargo), as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 December of each calendar year, aligned with the DG transport permit validity period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of DG endorsement after 30-day non-payment; continued operation without endorsement constitutes an offense under the Civil Aviation Act [Cap 216] or Maritime Act, attracting daily fines of VT 50,000 (approx. USD 420) and suspension of the operator certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] regardless of revenue, assets, or headcount. An independent audit becomes mandatory only as a condition of a special-purpose license (e.g., DG forwarding carrier bond or lender covenant) or where the registered agent is directed by the VFSC under an anti-money laundering investigation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by the Vanuatu Institute of Chartered Accountants; accounting records may alternatively be maintained under US GAAP where permitted by the corporate articles and not conflicting with the International Companies Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must obtain and record particulars of every beneficial owner at incorporation, file any UBO change with the VFSC within 14 days of a share transfer, and include an annual UBO confirmation in the Annual Return. Share transfer instruments must be executed by transferor and transferee, presented to the board, and recorded in the Register of Members within 21 days of transfer or such shorter period as prescribed by the articles.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger and transfer schedule)
Register of Beneficial Owners (maintained by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,800 per annum (registered agent, registered office, and corporate secretary package; risk-based uplift for DG freight forwarding customer relationships)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary in-country IFRS audit estimated at USD 8,000 - USD 20,000; lender-required US GAAP audit estimated at USD 15,000 - USD 30,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from all corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). There is no general corporate income tax in Vanuatu; consequently no preferential deduction regime or tax holiday is needed because the headline effective rate is already zero. The exemption is absolute for qualifying ICs provided they do not carry on business with Vanuatu residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for International Companies. Annual compliance is satisfied through the VFSC IC Annual Return, submitted electronically via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services portal or through the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and annual fee are due on the anniversary date of incorporation. There is no fiscal year-end income tax filing deadline because the entity is outside the corporate income tax net. If the IC has voluntarily elected to file a nil declaration with the Vanuatu Inland Revenue, such declaration must be filed within 30 days after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, company number, date of incorporation, registered office address (must be a physical address in Vanuatu maintained by a licensed agent), and registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the company as a non-resident-owned IC; confirm that the registered office is the only Vanuatu physical presence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B – Share Capital and Beneficial Ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, share classes, nominee shareholder details, and ultimate beneficial owner declarations as required under the Beneficial Ownership Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident legal or natural persons may own 100% of shares. BO information is recorded on a non-public VFSC register but must be accessible to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and service addresses of all directors, company secretary, and compliance officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; no local director is required, but a Vanuatu service address must be provided for each director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D – Activity and Exemption Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC does not conduct trade with Vanuatu residents, statement of foreign source income, and confirmation of the absence of a Vanuatu permanent establishment. If the IC is engaged in international DG freight forwarding, disclose the ISIC 5229 activity and the foreign operating jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers should mark the entity as exclusively offshore and should not list any Vanuatu-sourced revenue. No income tax computation is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment of the VFSC annual fee triggers a late penalty of VT 10,000 or 10% of the annual fee, whichever is higher, plus statutory interest of 1% per month. Continued default for 6 months leads to compulsory strike-off, loss of the tax exemption certificate, and director disqualification from managing any Vanuatu company.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, and the IC is not a tax resident for purposes of any double tax agreement. Because no DTA is in force, treaty relief is not applicable. Correspondents requiring documentary support should obtain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and a Letter of Exemption from the Vanuatu Commissioner of Inland Revenue describing the nil withholding exposure. Where a foreign payor demands a Tax Residency Certificate, such document cannot be issued; the IC must instead provide a statutory declaration of non-residence together with the certificate of incorporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate on royalties and interest paid by a Vanuatu IC is 0%. Vanuatu has not entered into comprehensive treaties with OECD or neighbouring states; consequently there is no reduced treaty rate to invoke. Payments for IP licences and intercompany loan interest to non-resident related parties are free from Vanuatu withholding tax and require no notification to the Inland Revenue.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None – Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation and imposes no local file/master file thresholds on International Companies. However, a foreign tax authority with jurisdiction over a related freight forwarding counterparty may impose its own documentation thresholds, so the IC should be prepared to produce contemporaneous arm’s length evidence for any intercompany charges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act and the VFSC regulatory guidance require an IC carrying on a geographically mobile relevant activity to demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu. Since ISIC 5229 dangerous goods freight forwarding is a cross-border service activity, the entity must show Vanuatu management and control; maintain board minutes in Vanuatu; retain all accounting records accessible in Vanuatu; and appoint a local compliance officer. If the core functions, risks, and assets of the DG forwarding chain remain overseas, the IC must nonetheless prove at least a minimal Vanuatu presence, otherwise it will be classified as a shell and subject to penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the International Company as a domestic freight forwarder within Vanuatu, invoicing Vanuatu resident clients, transporting hazardous goods by road between islands, or otherwise carrying on trade with Vanuatu residents without a domestic business licence, while continuing to claim the IC offshore exemption on the VFSC annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC exemption is void ab initio under Section 95 of the International Companies Act. The company becomes immediately liable to all applicable domestic impositions, including VAT registration, customs duties, and social insurance contributions. Civil penalty under the Value Added Tax Act may reach 150% of the unpaid VAT, and the Supreme Court may levy an additional fine of VT 50,000,000 for fraudulent exemption claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid VAT and customs duties during their tenure. They face director disqualification orders, civil restitution to the revenue authorities and creditors, travel bans while the assessment is pending, and imprisonment up to 7 years under Vanuatu's fraud and false statements legislation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Having no staff, no physical office, and no board meetings in Vanuatu while the entity is a counterparty to dangerous goods shipping contracts; issuing invoices and receiving freight payments through bank accounts in secrecy jurisdictions; and failing to provide any substantive records to the VFSC upon request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC can impose a penalty of VT 20,000,000 for the first non-compliant year and VT 400,000 for each subsequent month of continued non-compliance. The IC may be struck off summarily, its bank accounts restricted by the Financial Intelligence Unit, and its details communicated to the OECD and FATF, causing severe correspondent banking de-risking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal penalties up to VT 15,000,000 for certifying false substance declarations, a 10-year disqualification order, and a compensatory order requiring restitution of all fees earned through the sham structure. Continued non-substance activity can lead to criminal charges for negligent mismanagement under the Companies Act and imprisonment of up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing hazardous goods freight invoices through SWIFT wires and letters of credit without conducting beneficial ownership screening, end-user verification, or sanctions screening; using the IC as a conduit for layering payments to entities in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions; failing to report a suspicious transaction to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for more than 48 hours.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act [Cap. 260] imposes fines of VT 50,000,000 per contravention. Assets may be subject to a Preservation Order and receiver appointment for up to 90 days. The entity's special licence for dangerous goods forwarding is automatically suspended, and all letters of credit are rendered void at the issuing bank's option.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face civil restitution to all victims of the underlying fraud, 25-year imprisonment for money laundering, mandatory travel bans, and extradition to jurisdictions where the underlying hazardous goods shipment has caused environmental damage or personal injury. The corporate veil is pierced where the IC is used as a façade, and legal advisors who assisted in the layering may have their professional fees confiscated as tainted property.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Shipping dual-use chemical precursors, dangerous gases, or regulated hazardous substances to a destination or party under UN/EU/US sanctions; intentionally misdescribing the cargo on the bill of lading; or using the Vanuatu IC to conceal the identity of the actual freight forwarder from customs authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Customs Act and the United Nations Sanctions Act, the aircraft or vessel may be seized, the shipment forfeited, and the IC fined up to VT 100,000,000. The Vanuatu Dangerous Goods Transport Commission will revoke the licence, and the VFSC can dissolve the IC without the standard six-month wind-down period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for sanction violations and may be extradited under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act. Travel bans are mandatory. The Proceeds of Crime Act allows confiscation of personal assets held through family trusts. A director who issued the shipping instruction is treated as principal offender and can face life imprisonment where the goods were to be used in the manufacture of weapons of mass destruction.
